methods.name: checkMissing
methods.summary: Check which of the provided file hashes are missing from the Pages asset store.
methods.description:
Check which of the provided file hashes are missing from the Pages asset store.
Returns a list of missing hashes that need to be uploaded. Used as part of the
Pages Direct Upload workflow.

Authenticate with the JWT obtained from the upload-token endpoint: GET
/accounts/{account_id}/pages/projects/{project_name}/upload-token

props.name: hashes
props.description: List of file content hashes to check for existence in the asset store.

methods.name: upload
methods.summary: Upload one or more files to the Pages asset store.
methods.description:
Upload one or more files to the Pages asset store. Each file is identified by
its content hash and is uploaded using the same JSON shape as the Cloudflare KV
bulk write API. Used as part of the Pages Direct Upload workflow.

Authenticate with the JWT obtained from the upload-token endpoint: GET
/accounts/{account_id}/pages/projects/{project_name}/upload-token

props.name: base64
props.description: Whether value is base64 encoded.

props.name: key
props.description: File content hash used as the object key in the Pages asset store.

props.name: value
props.description: File content. When base64 is true, this value is base64 encoded.

methods.name: upsertHashes
methods.summary: Register the provided file hashes as recently uploaded to the Pages asset store.
methods.description:
Register the provided file hashes as recently uploaded to the Pages asset store.
Used as part of the Pages Direct Upload workflow so future deployments can avoid
re-uploading files that are already present.

Authenticate with the JWT obtained from the upload-token endpoint: GET
/accounts/{account_id}/pages/projects/{project_name}/upload-token

props.name: hashes
props.description: List of file content hashes to register in the asset store.
